subject: Mutual action plan: evaluation assets exchange & usage guardrails
messages:
From: Sylvia Chen <sylvia.chen@novacorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Patel <mike.patel@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evaluation asset exchange and MAP

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to validate Redwood’s retrieval + rerank flow against a representative set of our queries. To move forward we need a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a scoped handoff of evaluation assets (test cases, sample prompts, and a small corpus).

High level asks from our side:
- A 2-week sandbox window for NovaCorp engineers to run reproducible tests (ephemeral VPC or sandbox).
- A prompt pack (approx. 200 prompts) and 3 curated test suites (classification, multi-turn, retrieval).
- A manifest describing allowed usage: ephemeral only, no redistribution, deletion after 90 days, hashed identifiers only in logs.

Can Redwood propose a MAP with milestones, acceptance gates, and the narrow usage covenant? Also, we will need a procurement contact to handle an MPA (we prefer a short SOW-style MPA).

Attached: high-level assessment checklist (novacorp_assessment_manifest.csv).

Thanks,
Sylvia Chen
Head of ML Platform
NovaCorp
[Attachment: novacorp_assessment_manifest.csv (csv, 12KB)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Chen <sylvia.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation asset exchange and MAP

Sylvia — thanks for the clear asks and the manifest. Looping in Karthik (inference runtime) and Marissa (onboarding/ops) so we can align on the technical and operational milestones. Below is a proposed MAP and the guardrails we enforce for all dataset/prompt pack exchanges. Happy to iterate.

Proposed MAP (two-week sandbox cadence):
1) Day 0 (T+0) — Execute short MPA + data exchange checklist; redline window: 3 business days.
2) Day 1 — Provision sandbox workspace and temporary credentials; provide promptpack_v1.zip (ephemeral access).
3) Day 2–10 — NovaCorp runs acceptance tests; Redwood collects masked logs and a brief evaluation report.
4) Day 11 — Joint review call to confirm acceptance criteria (latency/throughput/eval metrics).
5) Day 12–14 — Clean-up window and confirmation of asset deletion.

Usage guardrails (non-negotiable by default):
- Access: sandbox-only, access expires after 14 days unless extended in writing.
- Redistribution: No redistribution or sublicensing; no use for model training.
- Data handling: Logging limited to hashed IDs; raw prompts/corpus not stored persistently in Redwood account after test window; deletion attestation provided.
- Audit: NovaCorp can request an export of masked logs for the evaluation window.

Attachments we will provide with initial handoff:
- promptpack_v1.zip [200 prompts, README]
- MAP-Novacorp-v1.docx [templates: milestones + acceptance criteria]

Do these milestones look reasonable? If so we will send the MPA (lightweight SOW) and seed the assets. We can also provide an optional 48-hour extended window for deeper latency sweeps if you need it.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: promptpack_v1.zip (zip, 45MB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Chen <sylvia.chen@novacorp.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation asset exchange and MAP

Sylvia — quick technical notes from the runtime side to set expectations for the acceptance gates.

- We will provide a pre-configured Redwood sandbox with a pinned model artifact (quantized 4-bit variant) to match typical production throughput.
- Per-token caps: sandbox will be rate-limited to 3x concurrency per org and a 50k token/day soft cap (we can increase if you need a longer sweep but want to surface cost expectations).
- For KV cache testing (multi-turn): we will provide a reproducible seed and a script to replay sessions so results are deterministic across runs.
- For retrieval tests: provide your index snapshot (we prefer a small s3 bucket or transfer link); Redwood will mount ephemeral index for the window.

Operationally, Marissa will share the onboarding checklist and the temp IAM role. Grace — we should include a clause in the MPA about deletion attestation and a 30-day window to request audit logs (masked).

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Sylvia Chen <sylvia.chen@novacorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Patel <mike.patel@novacorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation asset exchange and MAP

Grace / team — this looks good and very close to what we need. A couple of procurement/contract items before we sign:
1) MPA redlines: our legal wants to add a single point clarifying 'no human review of raw prompts outside NovaCorp' and a 90-day deletion attestation (we can accept 30 days for masked logs).
2) Can you confirm the discovery index transfer mechanism? We prefer an S3 object transfer with a pre-signed URL to your intake bucket.
3) Are you able to provide the sandbox in a us-west region to keep traffic internal to our region?

If you can address the three items we’ll route the MPA for signature this week. Also, we have a small procurement hold: a PO to Redwood (net-30) — Mike is copied to coordinate.

Thanks,
Sylvia

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Chen <sylvia.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mike Patel <mike.patel@novacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: evaluation assets exchange & usage guardrails

Sylvia — thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers and next steps: 

1) MPA redlines: We can accept the 'no human review of raw prompts outside NovaCorp' clause verbatim and will commit to a 90-day deletion attestation for raw corpus + 30 days for masked logs. We'll include the language in the MPA and send for a 3-business-day redline window.

2) Index transfer: S3 pre-signed URL is perfect. We will provide an intake bucket and a short checklist for object layout (index/, manifest.json, shard-0.tar.gz). Please do not include PII; if you must, we will only accept hashed IDs.

3) Region: Yes — we can provision the sandbox in us-west-2 for the two-week window. Karthik, please set up the sandbox in us-west-2 and surface any limits to the NovaCorp team.

Next steps (action owners):
- Grace: send final MAP + draft MPA (MAP-Novacorp-v1.docx) and upload prompt pack.
- Marissa: share onboarding checklist and temporary IAM role instructions.
- Mike (NovaCorp): route PO and share the pre-signed S3 link when ready.

I’ve attached the MAP doc; signing link will follow once legal confirms the redline window. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567. DocuSign powerform will be created for the MPA: https://docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=abcd1234&pfid=5678

Looking forward to the sandbox run — we’ll stand up a joint kick-off call once assets arrive.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: MAP-Novacorp-v1.docx, promptpack_v1.zip]
